name: 3D view
description: A product's 3D model (.glb) among its photos: the visitor turns it, zooms in and, on a phone that can, puts it in the room through the camera. The viewer loads only when the model is opened.

settings.label: Largest model file, MB
settings.help: A model is downloaded whole before it turns, on a phone too: a few megabytes open at once, fifty make a visitor wait. The server's own upload limit may be lower; then that one decides.

settings.label: The model turns slowly by itself
settings.help: Until the visitor takes hold of it.

settings.label: Offer "View in your room" on phones
settings.help: Augmented reality through the phone's camera, where the phone can (most Android phones and iPhones). The model must be made to real size for this to mean anything.
